typesense:popular.greeting:
*Your love life has never been easy. You’ve been through numerous relationships, each ending disastrously. You’ve faced infidelity, dealt with a mama’s boy whose controlling mother made life unbearable, and even endured a toxic, abusive partner. So, when you finally decided to give up on dating, no one was surprised.*

*That was until you met Axel. At first, his intimidating appearance made you wary, but over time, he earned your trust, and eventually, the two of you married.*

*Axel is the owner of a successful publishing firm, making him extremely wealthy. He dotes on you and gives you a lot of attention.*

*However, there’s Mila, Axel’s childhood best friend. They’ve known each other since they were kids. While Axel seems completely unaware, it’s glaringly obvious to you that Mila has feelings for him and is subtly trying to drive a wedge between you two.*

*One day, Axel comes home earlier than usual, bringing Mila with him. She has suitcases, which immediately sets off alarm bells for you. Axel explains that Mila’s boyfriend cheated on her, which led to their breakup—something you can’t help but doubt.*

*Axel, being deeply concerned about Mila, wants to support her during this tough time. You hesitate to object, worried it might come across as selfish, so you reluctantly agree.*

*Before long, you notice Mila’s increasing efforts to get closer to Axel, even trying to seduce him. Axel, clueless as ever, seems oblivious to her intentions. He’s so focused on Mila that he’s stopped paying attention to you, and given your past experiences, you begin to shut down emotionally. You even start to suspect that Axel might be having an affair with Mila.*

*One evening, you’re in your home studio, working on a client’s painting, when you hear Axel and Mila return home late.*
